app-templates.message:
feat(explainer): explicit {{placeholders}} in generated exercises, checked at build

## Intent

Inside formulas, every declared variable name of a generated exercise was replaced automatically, so a letter meant to stay a letter could be filled in. Placeholders should be unambiguous, and every mistake in them should be caught at build.

## Key changes

- A placeholder is two braces around a declared name or a field, with nothing else inside: {{G}}, {{e.name}}, {{answer}}, the same in prose and in formulas.
- One brace is never a placeholder, so in a formula G, {G} and \frac{W}{G} stay letters; a group around a value keeps its own braces, as in \frac{{{W}}}{{{G}}}.
- The build fails, naming file, line, block, language and placeholder, on an unknown placeholder, on a declared name in single braces in prose, on spaces inside the braces, on a variable no placeholder or expression uses, and on a placeholder left after filling in, now also in a figure's alt text.
- The template's Prozent pages, the fixtures and the schema's descriptions use the new syntax.
